subject: app.R did not return a shiny.appobj object error after deploying local shiny app

messages.author: deeb55e2063ab3df
messages.subject: app.R did not return a shiny.appobj object error after deploying local shiny app
parts:
1. shiny app with two files (app.R and data.RDS) on local computer works
2. deploy shiny app to shinyapps.io
3. receives the following error during deployment

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

Error in value[[3L]](cond) : app.R did not return a shiny.appobj object. Calls: local ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous> Execution halted


4. tries to debug error and finds the following page http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/single-file.html referenced by another question here on google group

404 Not Found

  • Code: NoSuchKey
  • Message: The specified key does not exist.
  • Key: articles/single-file.html
  • RequestId: 4A72003BBDFD1ABC
  • HostId: 97UwtylCJ+4TkpWdk5OzA+EAOatJyDXAtpPko4ZPa/0aca668glCAb7I+PiSXuzfSt8RVqZyOgE=


I'm stuck as to how to debug this issue. Is this saying app.R needs to split into two files? If no, what are the steps I can do to fix/debug this error?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: app.R did not return a shiny.appobj object error after deploying local shiny app
parts:
The shiny site was overhauled some months back.
My guess is that the content you are looking for is this: https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/app-formats.html
If you have a single file app.R, make sure your last line is shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
